title: SmartCitiManage
shortDesc: Final-year multi-agent AI system combining RAG, IoT and Digital Twin technology for smart cities.
fullDesc: SmartCitiManage is a multi-agent AI platform for urban infrastructure monitoring. It fuses IoT sensor streams with RAG-powered knowledge retrieval and a Digital Twin visual model, letting a team of specialized AI agents detect issues and surface recommendations. Built with a team of four.
